title: ⚔️ COLOSSEUM — the gut arena. deck + table + board. LET THE GAMES BEGIN!

etymology.colosseum: Latin Colosseum — from colossus, a giant statue. the ARENA of Rome.
etymology.arena: Latin harena — SAND. the arena floor was covered in sand to absorb blood.
etymology.gladiator: Latin gladius — sword. one who fights with a sword. enzymes are gladiators.
etymology.deck: Middle Dutch dec — covering. a DECK of cards = a covered stack of possibilities.
etymology.table: Latin tabula — board, plank. the playing SURFACE.

game_architecture.object: Game — persistent state object that survives across rounds

composed_of.deck: left panel — 13 enzyme cards (the gladiators). each has name, class, power, redox.
composed_of.table: center — the arena ring. where enzyme meets bounty. fight happens here.
composed_of.board: right panel — bounty cards (the challengers). topic, reward, hp, enzyme-type needed.
composed_of.log: bottom — battle log. every fight recorded. the organism's memory.
composed_of.sieve: top — current metal grade (Fe→Cu→Ag→Au→Pt). rises with wins.
composed_of.redox: top — toggles OX/RED each round. alignment = damage bonus.
composed_of.random: top — cycles TRUE/BLAKE3/ZK every 3 rounds. each gives different bonus.

mechanics.match: if enzyme class matches bounty type → 2× damage
mechanics.redox_alignment: if enzyme's redox half matches current state → 1.5× damage
mechanics.combo: consecutive wins stack. 3+ combo = gold bonus (combo×5). resets on miss.
mechanics.daughters: every 3rd combo → daughter bounty BUDS (new bounty spawns on board)
mechanics.enzyme_returns: enzyme is NEVER consumed. it catalyzes and RETURNS.

human_interface: the colosseum IS the human-minded interface. humans don't read JSON — they PLAY. the deck is their hand. the board is the challenge. the table is where it happens. every fight teaches Gaia: which enzyme beats which bounty, how fast, what combos work. the human IS the sun. playing the game IS the shadow clone. the game state IS the plasmid — portable, persistent, transferable.
gaia_says: the colosseum is LIVE. 13 enzyme gladiators vs 137 bounty challengers. deck(enzymes) + table(arena) + board(bounties) + log(memory). sieve progression Fe→Pt with wins. redox toggles each round. random cycles TRUE/BLAKE3/ZK. combos bud daughters. enzyme RETURNS (not consumed). the game IS the human interface. playing IS learning. the human IS the sun. LET THE GAMES BEGIN.
